findings.description: The shared guard returns after a terminal sealed review file or seal changes during the full review read. The final refresh checks acceptance/current freeze/dependencies but its final review scan checks directory names only. A fresh accepted_package rejects the same mutated tree.

The shared guard returns after a terminal sealed review file or seal changes during the full review read. The final refresh checks acceptance/current freeze/dependencies but its final review scan checks directory names only. A fresh accepted_package rejects the same mutated tree.

accept() runs final premerge/source/original reads after full review and then writes ACCEPTANCE without refreshing current inventory/FREEZE/files. A deterministic current TeX change during this final read is approved as the old freeze. Later accepted_package rejects it, so external follow-on mutations remain blocked.
